name: 30028 · Cumming, GA
findings: ZIP 30028 (Cumming) has 57 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (41% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30028 (Cumming) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 30028 (Cumming) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 50% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
